title: Equivariant Cohen coefficient extension and lift of a section
statement: Let $W$ be a complete discrete valuation ring of mixed characteristic $(0,p)$, with uniformizer $\pi$ and perfect residue field $k_0=W/\pi W$ [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $(C,\mathfrak n)$ be a complete Noetherian local $W$-algebra with local structure map and residue field $k'=C/\mathfrak n$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let a finite group $H$, of order invertible in $W$, act by local ring automorphisms on $W$ and $C$, compatibly with the structure map, hence on $k_0$ and $k'$. Suppose there is an $H$-equivariant $k_0$-algebra section $s:k'\to C/\pi C$ of the residue map. Then there exist a complete discrete valuation ring $V$ with local injective map $W\to V$, an identification $V/\pi V\cong k'$ (so $\pi$ is a uniformizer of $V$), and an $H$-action on $V$ compatible with the given actions on $W$ and $k'$. The map $W\to V$ is formally smooth for the maximal-ideal-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. There is an $H$-equivariant local $W$-algebra homomorphism $\psi:V\to C$ whose reduction modulo $\pi$ is $V\to k'\xrightarrow{s}C/\pi C$. Perfect means bijective Frobenius on $k_0$. No injectivity of $\psi$ is assumed or asserted for general $C$.

source.place: Exposé IV 4.3.5, p.60: Cohen rings I(k′H)→I(k′), lifted residue action and V=W⊗_{W(k0)}I(k′); equivariant lifting by isobarycentres, with square-zero lift torsor Lemma 4.3.6. Formal smoothness and the complete DVR property are the coefficient construction of 4.2.5 and 4.1.3–4.1.8.
